0022600007.text: Denver opens its 2026-27 season on the road against an Oklahoma City team that has also yet to play this season. The Nuggets will be without Julian Strawther, who is out with a knee sprain, and Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring issue and a game-time decision, while the Thunder are missing Otega Oweh, who is out after Achilles surgery. The Nuggets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3 but won their last meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Denver a 25% chance of winning this one.
